brief: Reads an optimization problem said as a sentence and builds the same stzOptimModel a hand-written model would give.
detail: The vocabulary is small and closed: maximize or minimize an expression, where a variable is between two numbers, at least or at most one, a whole number or binary, and keeping an expression under, over or at a number. An ambiguity is refused with a finding rather than guessed. The sentence calls the model's own methods, so there is one model class and one expression compiler. StzOptimNaturally(text) reads and builds in one call.
receiver: o1 = new stzOptimSentence("maximize 3*x + 2*y" + char(10) + "where x is between 0 and 40" + char(10) + "and y is a whole number at least 0" + char(10) + "keeping x + y under 50")
